text:
Priya: Quick intake — we just got a partner request to onboard 'tundra-7b-v2'. Need a fast quantization plan + smoke eval to unblock Dedicated bring-up. TL;DR: prioritize lowest-cost config that meets conv_score >= 0.92 on the regression suite. Thoughts?

Alex: +1. Can we start with per-channel int8 symmetric -> GGUF output? Fast and supported across our infra. Need to validate instruction-following and perplexity.

Sam: FYI last time a similar arch had attention kernel mismatch on A100 when we forced bf16. Suggest we keep fp32 baseline and plan fp8-hybrid as a fallback if int8 drops quality.

Jun: Proposed two-path plan: 1) per-channel int8 (fast path) 2) fp8-hybrid (compat path). Calibration set: 1k stratified samples by length/instruction-type to start.

Priya: Acceptance criteria: conv_score >= 0.92, and rouge-like metric within 2% of fp32 baseline. Latency must be <= baseline * 1.10. If not, escalate.

Alex: Spinning a quick calib run now. Command I'm using:
```
python infra/quantize.py --model tundra-7b-v2 --out gguf --algo perchannel_int8 --calib-file data/calib/stratified_1k.jsonl --batch 16 --cores 8
```

Alex: Initial log snippet:
```
[INFO] loading model: tundra-7b-v2
[INFO] calib samples: 1000
[WARN] layer 45: high delta in fc_out
[INFO] completed quant step 1/3
```

EvalBot: smoke eval started on infra/runner/fast-smoke — 100 prompts. Metrics: conv_score: 0.894, exact_match: 0.71. Tag: perchannel_int8-gguf.

Priya: 0.894 is below threshold. Next steps: increase calib diversity to 2k, enable bias-correction for per-channel, and run with gguf residual-fix flag. Also track where conv drops (long answer vs codegen).

Sam: Agreed. The current suite is short-answer heavy. I'll push stratified_2k_long.jsonl to data/calib and prioritize long-context.

Jun: If per-channel still fails, try hybrid_fp8 with kernel fallback config:
```
--algo hybrid_fp8 --act-quant=fp8 --weight-quant=int8 --fallback=kernel_flex
```

Alex: Queuing both runs now (per-channel w/2k / hybrid_fp8). ETA ~6h on the smoke cluster. Tagging @Priya @Jun. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya: Add intake note: "If per-channel int8 fails by >0.03 conv_score vs fp32, escalate to research for layerwise retraining or QAT." Also include cost delta targets (per-token <= -35% vs fp32 to prefer int8).

DeployBot: Scheduled job 2004001234-quant-run-1 created (owner: Alex).

Alex: Will post final conv_score + p95 latency here when runs finish. If fp8 chosen, will include estimated per-token cost delta and any kernel compatibility notes.

Priya: Thanks team. Keep updates short — final decision criteria = conv_score + latency + per-token cost. If research needs to step in, open a follow-up thread and tag "eng-ml-research". :thumbsup:
